rationale.claim: In every positive-characteristic ACFH model, parameter-free inverse Frobenius commutes with theta and is outside the faithful integral polynomial subring Z[theta]. Adjoining it gives a faithful strict Z[1/p][theta] subring.
rationale.identity: This is the unrestricted all-characteristics equality of original30005356/OWR-12697685-001, also identified as OWR2023 printed97–98/arXiv2212.02115v4 Question5.8. A characteristic-p counterexample settles that literal universal equality.
rationale.limits: No characteristic-zero classification, full localized equality, final-APAL wording, present openness or firstness certification. Classical inverse Frobenius, d’Elbee faithfulness and the Chini reduct/richer-language distinction are credited.
